title: Continuous conormal tangent and completed deformation comparison data
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field] and $A$ a local commutative $k$-algebra. Write $\widehat A$ for its maximal-ideal-adic completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. For a surjective presentation $P\to A$ with kernel $J$, use the actual complex $C=[J/J^2\to A\otimes_P\Omega^1_{P/k}]$ of [lem-trf-lci-naive-cotangent-model]. A finite localized polynomial presentation means $P$ is a localization of $k[t_e:e\in E]$ for a finite set $E$, with its specified scalar map. Define the completed complex $\widehat C=\widehat A\otimes_A C$ by scalar extension [def-weil-module-base-change] and its continuous Ext-one to be $\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\widehat A)}(\widehat C,\widehat A[1])$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For Noetherian $A$ the Ext map is the actual exact scalar-extension functor with its shift, single-object and coefficient-unit comparisons. Tangent class sets are marked isomorphism classes in the flat algebra deformation groupoid [def-sfb-marked-flat-algebra-deformations] over $k[\epsilon]/\epsilon^2$. A completion of a representative $Q$ is a marked deformation with specified algebra isomorphism to the completion of $Q$ at the inverse image of $\mathfrak m_A$, fixing the scalar map and every finite-quotient marking. A continuous tangent comparison is an equivalence from marked completed tangent classes to the continuous Ext-one group, together with the actual completion map on classes. Normalize the equivalence on every polynomial lift: the image of $j\in J$ is the coefficient of $\epsilon$ in the lifted relation, and the resulting cocycle $\widehat C\to\widehat A[1]$ represents the assigned class. Require such representatives for every deformation and compatibility with every actual completion.
